sections: Vector Tail Agnostic and Vector Mask Agnostic
predicates: Signed and unsigned ordering differ at SEW sign boundary; equality includes equal-zero and equal-sign values.
Scalar RV32 sign extension and signed simm5 precede unsigned interpretation.
Mask destination EEW1 occupies one full register; destination v0 is legal, including masked AND behavior.
Compare tails always agnostic; old,one,or computed result within VLMAX permitted.
Overlap at lowest source register is legal narrowing; differing EEW overlap implies agnostic inactive state.
Prestart and no-body bits and non-destination registers must preserve.
Independent reference compares every enabled body bit from captured prestate.
